title: Why You Shouldn't Wash Your Turkey 🦃 #Shorts
description:
Why you shouldn't wash your turkey: rinsing does not wash the bacteria off. It splashes them onto your sink, your counter and your salad. In a USDA study of people rinsing raw poultry, 60% had bacteria in the sink afterward and 26% got it onto their salad. Only heat kills the germs: skip the rinse, cook the turkey to 165°F and check it with a food thermometer, then scrub the sink with hot, soapy water.

Explained in 60, podcast edition. You've Been Doing It Wrong.
